payload.claim: For a ±10% Bitcoin grid bot with 20 levels (W≈0.20, δ≈1%, fee=0.1%) at 36% annualized volatility, the expected net monthly return on a random walk is approximately -0.5% of capital, equal to the fee cost.
payload.quote: Take a ±10% Bitcoin grid with 20 levels: W ≈ 0.20, δ ≈ 1%, f = 0.1%. At 36% annual volatility, daily σ is about 1.9%, so 30 days of squared moves add up to about 0.0107. The harvest is 0.0107 × C/2W (= 2.5) × 0.8 ≈ 2.1% of capital. On a random walk the expected cost is 0.0107 × 2.5 ≈ 2.7%. Net: about −0.5% a month, which is exactly the fees.
